title: How a backpack helped save a homeless former football star
summary_full: A serendipitous encounter in Austin sparked a life-altering change for Sampson James, the former Indiana football star who found himself homeless. After noticing James's worn backpack, IU graduate Jasper Steinmetz rallied support, leading to a remarkable $17,000 in donations. This much-needed generosity has enabled James to secure a new apartment, providing him with a valuable opportunity for a fresh start.
